description: Search the WaitingForPower dataset of U.S. energy projects (generation, transmission, storage, LNG, pipelines) currently stuck waiting on permitting approval. Returns a paginated summary (including oppositionCount and nextHearingDate); call get_project with a slug for full detail (sources, milestone timeline, hearings, opposition records). Example: "solar projects in Texas waiting 3+ years" -> state=TX, fuelType=[solar], minYearsWaiting=3. Read-only.

fuelType.description: Filter to one or more fuel/technology types.

minCapacity.description: Only projects with capacity at least this many MW.

minYearsWaiting.description: Only projects waiting at least this many years.

offset.description: Number of matching results to skip, for paging.

projectType.description: Filter to one or more project types.

stage.description: Filter to one or more current permitting stages.

state.description: USPS state code, e.g. "CA". Omit for all states.

status.description: Which status bucket to search. Defaults to "in_permitting" (the site's original "still waiting" scope) if omitted — pass "permits_complete", "cancelled_suspended", "no_longer_reported", or "all" to reach approved, cancelled, or untracked-by-source projects too.

name: search_projects
title: Search energy projects
